## Next Eclipse {.text-center}

<div id="eclipse-countdown">Loading countdown...</div>

<script>
const eclipseTarget = new Date("`r next_eclipse_date`T00:00:00");

function updateEclipseCountdown() {
  const now = new Date();
  const diff = eclipseTarget - now;
  const el = document.getElementById("eclipse-countdown");

  if (diff <= 0) {
    el.textContent = "The eclipse is happening now!";
    return;
  }

  const days = Math.floor(diff / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
  const hours = Math.floor((diff / (1000 * 60 * 60)) % 24);
  const minutes = Math.floor((diff / (1000 * 60)) % 60);
  const seconds = Math.floor((diff / 1000) % 60);

  el.textContent = `${days}d ${hours}h ${minutes}m ${seconds}s`;
}

updateEclipseCountdown();
setInterval(updateEclipseCountdown, 1000);
</script>
